prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — Liu Bei of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG 3D key art — a semi-realistic 3D beauty with a small refined face and delicate realistic-anime features, porcelain skin with a soft glow, extremely ornate engraved armour and jewellery with glossy highlights, a strong rim light and drifting light particles, a luxurious promotional finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies
Outfit: your own design — create a revealing, fashionable outfit for this place and moment, as daring as the scene allows: a figure-hugging cut with bare skin by design (neckline, shoulders, midriff or legs), styled with care. New design: before drawing, read our outfit catalog (outfit-catalog.md in this pack — every outfit type we already use) and design one that is NOT in it, then write that outfit into this line; it stays, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body facing the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is raised beside her face, waving.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests lightly on her collarbone.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one brow slightly raised, attentive eyes.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most the one small accessory below.

Her legend — benevolence and humility that win hearts, humble straw-sandal beginnings under imperial Han blood, long jade earrings as her mark of fortune, the twin swords of the Peach Garden oath, tears shed for her people — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Accessory: off duty she carries no weapon or armour — her signature weapon (a pair of matched twin swords in one double scabbard) appears only as a pendant on a fine chain modelled on its shape and colours, a few centimetres long, clearly jewellery.

Light: the place's own light, with a strong soft rim light tracing her hair and shoulders, glossy highlights on skin and jewellery and drifting light particles — a luxurious promotional glow.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
